description: Downloadable models and conversion recipes for Apple's Core AI on iPhone and Mac. Chat, vision, speech and generative models with per-model validation records, Swift examples through CoreAIKit, and a downloadable Mac app.
summary: Community model zoo for Apple Core AI (iOS/macOS 27): 62 models — LLM, VLM, OCR, ASR, TTS, image/video/music gen, forecasting — each gated against its source model and shipped with the recipe that produced it. Downloadable from Hugging Face, runnable in one line of Swift via CoreAIKit. Plus benchmar
